investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Maplepoint Mutual (insurance); Platform: AWS eu-west-1 (zones eu-west-1a/eu-west-1b/eu-west-1c); network range 10.221.0.0/16; Database: mysql server claims-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-dd0cb9a638f34a7fb; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
